verbose.description: Enable verbose output in init.d script (yes/no)

print_confnames.description: Print configuration file names in init.d script output (yes/no)

inherited_config.description: Path to the inherited default configuration file

virtualenv.description: Path to Python virtual environment directory

home.description: Alias for virtualenv (use only if different from virtualenv); leave blank to auto-inherit

uid.description: System user ID or username to run worker processes as

gid.description: System group ID or group name to run worker processes as

chdir.description: Working directory to change into before loading app

socket.description: Unix socket path for inter-process communication (typically with Nginx)

http.description: Optional HTTP interface (e.g., ':8080') for direct testing or frontend without reverse proxy

processes.description: Number of worker processes to spawn

threads.description: Number of threads per worker (set >1 only if app is thread-safe)

master.description: Enable master process for graceful reloads and process management

lazy_apps.description: Load app after fork (reduces memory copy-on-write overhead in multi-process setups)

reload_mercy.description: Time (seconds) master waits before forcefully killing old workers on reload

max_requests.description: Max requests per worker before graceful respawn (helps prevent memory leaks)

logto.description: Path to log file (if not using syslog)

logfile.description: Alternative path to log file (alias for logto)

logto_syslog.description: Syslog identifier (e.g., 'uwsgi') to log to syslog; empty to disable

emperor.description: Enable Emperor mode: directory to scan for config files (e.g., '/etc/uwsgi/vassals')

vacuum.description: Remove temp files (socket, pidfile) on shutdown

post_buffering.description: Buffer size (KB) for POST data (increase for large form/file uploads)

virtualhost.description: Enable virtualhost mode for name-based routing

thunder_lock.description: Prevent thundering herd by serializing accept() calls

buffer_size.description: Internal buffer size (bytes) for request/response handling
